risk_acceptance: The 925 unread training dialogues may contain factual, instruction, style, privacy and content errors despite publisher ratings and earlier foundation screening. The 25 considered examples also have recorded limitations and are not factual gold. Accept this residual noise only for a finite private learning experiment to measure whether assistant-target SFT improves the actual weak foundation checkpoint. A 950-row pilot is not sufficient evidence of broad conversational readiness. Stop/revise on observed regressions; conduct a real conversation and direct score before the following iteration.
